accountant_review.description: Its request has a final step the Accountant signs, as every member who could sign benefits from a settlement of their own (FM-9) [accountant to confirm].

acra.description: An approved conversion: its ACRA steps and what they raise (FR-EQ-09).

agreements.description: How many files are attached and not removed: asking for approval needs one, the loan note, minute or deed.

approval_asked.description: The pending request to decide it.

checks.description: A draft's statuses: ✖ while no agreement is attached, or while it does not fit what is owed now.

conversion.description: A conversion's class, price and basis, capacity and measurement basis.

date.description: The day it was last drafted.

deducted_earlier.description: A decided waiver of amounts the company deducted earlier as costs (pay or fees on 2120): tagged for the tax computation [verify].

lapses_on.description: An approved conversion not yet effective: the day the shareholders' approval lapses, the date by which the next AGM must be held [verify]; after it a new approval is needed.

ledger_impact.description: A waiver's entry: the lines it would post as a dry run while undecided (FR-APR-02), and the lines it posted once decided; empty for a loan kept.

owed.description: What the company owes the person on the account today.

repaid.description: A decided repayment: what payment batches have repaid of it, net of voids; the rest is open for the next batch.

repay_to.description: A repayment: the account in force it is paid into, the linked member's own (FR-AP-22) or else the contact's (FR-CT-03), by its last four characters; absent while there is none.

share_issue.description: An effective conversion: its share issue in the register.

shares.description: A conversion: the whole shares RND-SHARE allots, what they convert and what stays owed.

status.description: draft; waiting for another person's approval; decided: the loan kept, the repayment payable by a payment batch, the waiver posted, or the conversion approved and pending ACRA's register; or effective: the conversion's shares in the register and posted.

version.description: The version of its content; with its status it makes the ETag.

waiver.description: A waiver's account, capacity and reason.
